[All reconstruction reports](index.md) · [Material and EOS parameters](../material-summaries/feo.md) · [EOSMAT record file](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/materials/feo.eosmat) · [Audit sidecar](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/audits/feo.audit.json)

Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Fischer et al. (2011), BM3, iron-saturated FeO

**reproduced** · `feo_fischer_2011_bm3_2` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/feo.md#record-feo_fischer_2011_bm3_2)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

- Conditional current-study thermal reproduction: all 42 numerical B1 volumes in Fischer Supplementary Table S1 are evaluated at their reported, already 3%-corrected temperatures with Equation (1)'s integrated-Gruneisen Mie-Gruneisen-Debye model. V0, theta0, q, Tr, and n are held fixed exactly as the source specifies. Fischer's published global fit also includes Campbell, Ozawa, and Seagle rows. All identifiable source tables are now bundled, but Campbell's fcc-Fe calibration is retained only as deferred source evidence because of unresolved coefficient-refit discrepancies. It is not an executable calibration; Fischer's final combined row selection remains unresolved. The source also does not state its regression weights, residual variable, covariance, or optimizer; this result remains a current-study-only diagnostic rather than an exact global-fit reproduction. See the \[dedicated Fischer reproduction\](literature-reproductions/fischer-2011-feo.md).

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** feo\_fischer\_2011\_table\_s1\_pvt
- **Observations:** 42
- **Fit kind:** joint\_pvt
- **Selection:** all 52 Table S1 rows; finite B1 volumes retain 42 phase-specific observations at their reported temperatures
- **Objective:** errors\_in\_variables
- **Absolute sigma:** True
- **Free parameters:** rt\_eos.K0; rt\_eos.K0\_prime; gamma0
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; Tr; theta0; q; n

<a id="record-feo_campbell_2009_bm3_mgd"></a>

## Campbell et al. (2009), B1 FeO, 295 K BM3-Debye

**disagrees** · `feo_campbell_2009_bm3_mgd` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/feo.md#record-feo_campbell_2009_bm3_mgd)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** Conditional reproduction, not an exact recovery of the unpublished regression protocol. Campbell specifies least squares but no residual variable, weights, covariance, or final row mask. The main diagnostic uses equal pressure-residual weights and simultaneous fitting of the three Table 1 free parameters. Fe/FeO main fits use current-study Table S2 only: Seagle contributes 81 recoverable V-T pairs but no individual pressures or NaCl observations. Separate sensitivities reconstruct 65 hcp-calibrated pressures using benchmark-checked Seagle (2006), compare its conflicting reference volumes, and optionally retain 16 unresolved rows as nominal-isobar estimates. A separate protocol audit adds 14 conditional fcc pressures from Funamori/Boehler/Basinski, leaving only two missing-iron-volume rows without individual pressures. The exact historical fcc reduction and combined regression remain unresolved. These are derived pressures, not original row-level pressure data. The published Fe/FeO records are deferred from the executable catalog because the combined-data mismatch remains unresolved. No refitted coefficients replace the source records. See literature-reproductions/campbell-2009-buffers.md.

**Source review:** `deferred`.

- substantial combined-data coefficient-refit discrepancy
- exact Seagle pressure reduction used by Campbell
- author regression inputs, row selection and fitting procedure

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** feo\_campbell\_2009\_table\_s2\_pvt
- **Observations:** 25
- **Fit kind:** conditional\_bm3\_mgd\_variable\_exponent
- **Selection:** All Table S2 rows for FeO; only its 15 explicitly fcc rows for Fe. For Ni/NiO, retain all 92 heated/MAP Table S3 rows (T&gt;295 K); exclude its nine 293-295 K quenched DAC rows from the main diagnostic. This exclusion follows the Section 2.2 stress warning but is an audit choice: the authors do not publish a regression row mask. All 101 rows are retained in the dataset and tested in a sensitivity refit.
- **Objective:** pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** unweighted
- **Free parameters:** rt\_eos.K0; gamma0; q
- **Fixed parameters:** V0; K0\_prime; Tr; theta0; n
